title: Terraforming the Sahara with thunderstorm generators during the humid period

tellings.quote: So these fertilizers are utilized in conjunction with white horseill cumulone nimbus thunderstorm generators for terraforming applications within the upper eastern Sahara.

plain: Long ago, when the Sahara was wetter and greener, someone supposedly used fertilizers together with machines that made huge thunderstorms to reshape the land of the upper eastern Sahara and make it livable. The researcher Geoffrey Drumm lays this out as his own theory, naming no source. If true, it would mean an ancient people could engineer the weather.
